profile.headline: Consultant, Senior Software Engineer at Xerox, Inc. - Public Transportation Fare Systems
profile.summary:
Creative and analytical hands-on problem solver with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, US Citizen.

Experienced object-oriented programmer and developer with proven analyzing, conceptualizing, designing, coding, and debugging skills. Experienced designing new code and working with legacy code.

Experienced developing multi-threaded and multi-process Unix and Linux applications with C++ classes implemented using virtual and pure virtual methods as well as overloaded methods, using networking and inter-thread and inter-process messaging and communication and thread synchronization using mutexes and condition variables.

Experienced developing networking and network messaging for Linux/Unix client-server systems, using TCP/IP, UDP, and IP Multicast protocols, with the C, C++, Java, Eclipse, and Perl languages.

Experienced developing multi-threaded and multi-process Windows applications using CORBA, SOAP, and event objects, mutexes and critical sections. Experienced designing and developing WCF clients and Windows applications using C#, XML, and SQLite.

Experienced with data feeds and FIX messaging for equity trading.

Experienced using databases and developing SQL with MySQL and Oracle on Linux and Unix platforms.

Experienced developing data structures and algorithms using the STL, Java Collections, and C, C++, and Java directly.

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from New Jersey Institute of Technology, Newark, NJ; graduate courses in Computer Science at Stevens Institute of Technology, Hoboken, NJ.

positions.title: Consultant, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and debugged C++ DLLs to work with existing infrastructure to support hardware and functionality that was required for new customer platform. Designed, coded, and debugged C++ DLLs to support remote software updates, commands, and alerts.

Used the following technologies:
Multi-threaded, multi-process C++ on Windows platform with DLLs, event objects, critical sections, and mutexes

Design patterns

SQL, CORBA, SOAP (HTTP and HTTPS), XML, C#, WCF

company.name: Xerox, Inc. - Public Transportation Fare Systems

positions.title: Consultant, Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and debugged new software to enhance automated regression test suite that validated ability of connection destinations (FIX 4.0, FIX 4.1, NYFIX, NYSE, etc.) to process order types (Market, Limit, Stop, Stop Limit, etc.) for customers' order management systems. Completely revamped existing Ant build for full automation. Automated generation of order-flow execution-speed reports.

Used the following technologies:
Core Java, Eclipse, Ant, JUnit, mock objects
FIX
MySQL, phpMyAdmin, JDBC
Perl, HTML, CVS

company.name: EZX Inc. - Provider of Java-based API for sending Order Flow to Exchanges, ECNs, and brokers

positions.title: Associate, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and debugged Java server to simulate connection to Nasdaq for use in testing BBH application that reported NAVs to Nasdaq. Designed, coded, and debugged re-usable framework of C++ classes to manage publishing of Mutual Fund Data reports to Oracle databases with report content determined by pseudo-SQL meta-data. Developed on-going maintenance fixes to undocumented third-party C++ code that interacted with Oracle databases, including correcting malfunctioning rollback/replay for prorated fixed-income funds with average-cost, constant-yield processing, and correcting incorrect or redundant records in reports with foreign currencies.

Used the following technologies:
Core Java, Eclipse, networking, collections, threads, SAXParser, XML, regex parsing

C++, STL, design patterns

SQL (Oracle)

Flex/bison (lex/yacc)

company.name: Brown Brothers Harriman - Investment and Wealth Management unit

positions.title: Technical Specialist, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and debugged multi-threaded C++ application framework implementing depth-of-book server for BRUT/Nasdaq. Completely re-designed and re-coded BRUT's proprietary FIX engine to substantially increase operational reliability, improve maintainability, and reduce cost, time, and effort to add order-flow destinations. Designed, coded, and debugged Java application to search log files for NYSE DirectPlus order-entry rule violations.

Used the following technologies:
C++, STL, pthreads, mutexes, condition variables, Unix signals, design patterns

TCP/IP, IP multi-cast, messaging (inter-thread)

Core Java, regex parsing

positions.title: Consultant, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and debugged multi-threaded C++ real-time market data system that extracted market data content from several feeder systems and generated FIX Market Data messages to clients. Designed, coded, and debugged multi-threaded C++ Market Data Distribution system that received all market data from feeder systems and distributed client-requested data via publish-subscribe middleware. Designed, coded, and debugged an Initiator FIX Engine to test and certify a third-party (Javelin) FIX Engine, using Perl/Tk.

Used the following technologies:
C++, template classes, STL, pthreads, mutexes, condition variables, design patterns

FIX

TCP/IP, IP multi-cast

Publish/subscribe middleware, TIBCO/Talarian Smart Sockets middleware

Perl, Perl/Tk
